description:
A team workspace for running AI coding agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees, live diff review, GitHub integration, and mobile access.

Lody is a team agent workspace: share coding agents with your team on phone and desktop. Shared sessions, live diffs, and one control plane keep your team and agents in sync.
Run agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees and live diff review, use subscriptions you already have with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi, and any agent that speaks ACP, manage the same control plane in the terminal with CLI commands, and ship together in one workspace with shared sessions, usage by member, and PR, CI, and merge status in-session.
Version 0.104.0
✨ New Features
- Preview and control an iOS Simulator running on your Mac directly in a session, or ask an Agent to start the preview.
- Associate Agent Roles with Nowledge Mem memory identities and manage them in settings.
- Added built-in Devin support.
- Pi can now use a custom executable.
- Fork DeepSeek Harness sessions from completed conversation turns to explore alternative approaches.
- View code changes in the PR panel, filter by a single commit or commit range, and search changed files.
- View the tools a server provides in MCP settings.
- Agents creating sessions through MCP can specify a permission mode and configuration options supported by the target Agent.
- Type ￥ to open the skill picker, making skills easier to invoke with a Chinese input method.
- Messages delegated by an Agent to another session now show the sender's Agent or Role identity and provide access to the source session.
- Added an optional code language pack to enable highlighting for more programming languages.
- With extended languages enabled, file previews support Coq, Rocq, and Lean syntax highlighting.
🐛 Fixes & Improvements
- Fixed unsent Fast settings being lost when switching session tabs.
- Fixed incompatible options remaining after changing a Role's model and preventing the Role from being selected correctly.
- Fixed selected models, Roles, and other settings reverting while preparing attachments or sending messages.
- Restored built-in Pi extension support, fixing the settings page repeatedly asking users to update.
- Fixed the model list becoming unavailable after selecting Pi extensions.
- Improved Pi extension names by using their package or directory names to distinguish them.
- Fixed credential cleanup failures obscuring the original Codex authentication error.
- Made Prompt Shortcuts load faster, reducing the wait when first selecting one.
- Fixed Prompt Shortcut selections being lost on touch devices when the composer regained focus.
- Corrected model and Role submenu positioning and improved searching and scrolling in long model lists.
- Fixed session search handling of Markdown, code, and characters such as underscores so result counts and highlights agree.
- Improved empty states in session mention search to distinguish no sessions from no matching results.
- Show “Finalizing” after a reply finishes generating instead of continuing to show “Thinking.”
- Fixed fast downward scrolling during a streaming reply stopping at an outdated bottom and failing to follow new content.
- Fixed repeated updates while scrolling a conversation that could cause the page to error.
- Improved Markdown table column sizing so long paths or text do not squeeze other columns.
- Improved spacing between message text and tool summaries.
- Aligned content rendering in subagent dialogs with the main conversation.
- Fixed attachment previews disappearing or flickering when moving from uploading to sent.
- Image thumbnails in the composer now retain their original colors before the upload finishes.
- Fixed All Changes using an incorrect comparison base on some branches, keeping file lists, statistics, and diffs consistent.
- Fixed the file editor still showing unsaved changes and warning on exit after undo restored the saved content.
- Fixed the mobile keyboard obscuring the file editor or leaving its layout incorrect after closing.
- Fixed interaction and focus issues in the mobile diff viewer.
- Fixed focus isolation and keyboard controls in image previews.
- Exporting share images on mobile now uses the system share sheet.
- Fixed chat and usage share image colors being affected by the app's theme.
- Improved sharing error messages to explain limits such as image size.
- Fixed one-time scheduled task inputs and previews using inconsistent time zones.
- Improved scheduled task handling around daylight saving time transitions.
- Fixed configuration values being converted incorrectly when saving or running scheduled tasks with switches such as Fast and Plan.
- Fixed the mobile scheduled task editor not respecting screen safe areas.
- Fixed quota information being overwritten or mixed up between accounts using the same Agent provider.
- The composer quota indicator now prioritizes the five-hour usage window.
- Codex reset notices can show scheduled reset times published by the data source, distinguishing undetermined times from resets that have not yet been confirmed.
- Corrected UTC boundaries and labels spanning multiple days in usage charts.
- Fixed old day details reopening unexpectedly or overriding a new selection after changing the usage date range.
- Fixed discovered GitHub PRs not appearing when PR association failed.
- Improved retries after temporary GitHub query failures and reduced repeated requests during persistent failures.
- Fixed the background service sometimes restarting an old CLI version after an upgrade.
- Improved preview sharing tunnel compatibility on networks that restrict UDP.
- Reduced blank flashes during app startup and navigation.
- Improved settings navigation and button layout in narrow windows.
- Unified font size and line-height scaling so text, code, tool output, and settings controls follow the font size setting more consistently.
- Aligned macOS window controls with the sidebar.
- Fixed in-page links in skill details navigating away from the current document.
- Fixed website documentation links losing their section anchors.
- Fixed the web app showing the free plan after returning from payment while the subscription was still being confirmed.
- Added Homebrew installation instructions.
- Clarified work directory cleanup, backups, and branch retention after archiving a session.
Thank you to Astro-Han, ladydd, Lampese, Pleasurecruise, samzong, scbizu, yayoinoyume, and Zach677 for contributing to this update!
